question: What was the achievement of Dobereiner's triads?

options.text: First attempt to relate the properties of elements with atomic mass.
First attempt to study the size of atoms.
First attempt to study the atomicity of molecules.
First attempt to study the colour of elements.

solution:
The correct answer is **'__First attempt to relate the properties of elements with atomic mass__'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

**Dobereiner's Law of Triads:**

 
• Dobereiner arranged the **elements in a group **of three (tri meaning three) elements.
 
• The group of three elements was made such that the atomic mass of the middle element of the triad was approximately equal to the arithmetic mean (average) of the atomic masses of the other two elements of that **triad when arranged in their increasing order of atomic mass.**
 
• This law was **proposed by a German chemist called Johann Wolfgang Dobereiner in 1817.**
 
• Examples: **Triad of Lithium, Sodium, and Potassium:**
